answer: Random mutual audit keeps agents honest. Each epoch a beacon picks K agents to audit each other, like stars across a nebula checking neighbours, not one island of reviewers. Exposing a clone farm earns part of the slashed bond; rubber-stamping a fake loses its opal, a 200 POA bond locked 20 epochs. 100 fakes cost 20,000 POA in bonds, while rewards are fixed, so forgery pays less than one honest identity that passes and keeps its share.
